units.desc: Full ticker universe: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/tickers — save raw, then upsert EVERY entry into the tickers table via mq_db.upsert_ticker
GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/market-status/{exchange} for: NYSE, NASDAQ, CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX, CBOE, ICE, BINANCE, COINBASE, OANDA. Save every response (even 4xx).
GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/prices?tickers=SPX,SPY,QQQ,NDX,IWM,RUT,DIA,VIX (one batched call; if it fails, per-ticker calls).
GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/prices?tickers=NVDA,TSLA,AAPL,MSFT,AMZN,META,GOOGL,AVGO,AMD,PLTR,NFLX,COIN (batched; fallback per-ticker).

GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/screeners/columns; GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/screeners?columns=name,quote_type,sector,industry,market_cap,volume&tickers=SPX,SPY,QQQ,NVDA,TSLA,AAPL,MSFT,AMZN,META,GOOGL; GET chat-service /api/web/v1/screeners.
GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/gamma-levels/{t}/eod for t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NDX,IWM,RUT,DIA,VIX.
GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/gamma-levels/{t}/intraday for t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NDX,IWM,RUT,DIA,VIX (4xx is fine, save it).
GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/gamma-levels/{t}/eod AND /intraday for t in NVDA,TSLA,AAPL,MSFT,AMZN,META.
GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/gamma-levels/{t}/eod AND /intraday for t in GOOGL,AVGO,AMD,PLTR,NFLX,COIN.
For t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NDX,IWM,VIX: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/gamma-insights/{t}?limit=20 AND /api/web/v1/gamma-insights/{t}/expirations?frequency=eod.
For t in NVDA,TSLA,AAPL,MSFT,AMZN,META: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/gamma-insights/{t}?limit=20 AND /api/web/v1/gamma-insights/{t}/expirations?frequency=eod.
For t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NDX,IWM,RUT,DIA,VIX: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/metrics/{t}/eod?fields=option&fields=momentum&fields=volatility&fields=seasonality&limit=30.
For t in NVDA,TSLA,AAPL,MSFT,AMZN,META,GOOGL,AVGO: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/metrics/{t}/eod?fields=option&fields=momentum&fields=volatility&fields=seasonality&limit=30.
Probe: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/metrics/{t}/intraday?fields=option&fields=volatility&limit=30 for SPX,SPY,QQQ,NVDA (save whatever comes back, incl. 4xx).
For t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NVDA,TSLA,AAPL: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/options/matrix/{t}?frequency=intraday AND ?frequency=eod.
For t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NVDA,TSLA,AAPL: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/options/put-call-ratio/{t} AND /api/web/v1/dealer-positioning/{t} (probe, save all statuses).
For t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NDX,IWM,VIX,NVDA,TSLA: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/volatility-insights/{t}. Also probe /api/web/v1/price-ratios?tickers=SPX,SPY and /api/web/v1/levels-report?ticker=SPX.

For t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NVDA,TSLA: GET clickhouse-api /api/web/v1/tickers/{t}/candles?interval=5m&countBack=288 (add &from/&to ms epoch for last 24h if empty) AND ?interval=1d&countBack=60. Also GET /api/web/v1/tickers/SPX/tradingview.

GET qbot-service /api/web/v1/assets. For t in SPX,SPY,QQQ,NVDA,TSLA,AAPL: /api/web/v1/events?ticker={t}&kind=news_significant&start_date=<14 days ago>&end_date=<today> AND /api/web/v1/company-news?ticker={t}&date=<today>&number=12.

GET user-service /api/web/v1/users/me, /api/web/v1/watchlists, /api/web/v1/user-preferences?type=tradingview. GET chat-service /api/web/v1/chat-context, /api/web/v1/chats, /api/web/v1/screener-templates, /api/web/v1/templates?type=suggested. THEN scrape 4 account-site HTML pages via WebBridge (see brief section B).
